verdict.rationale: Better Auth documents a migration guide specifically for moving from Auth0 that explicitly covers importing email/password users with proper password hash handling, plus social accounts and 2FA data (docs-8, docs-30, docs-41). However, there is no evidence of a generic bulk-import tool for arbitrary user stores, nor any documented export functionality to avoid lock-in — the 'own your data in your own DB' claim is community sentiment (better-auth-comm-1) rather than a documented export feature. missing for 10: a generic (non-Auth0-specific) bulk import mechanism, explicit export/dump tooling, and independent confirmation that migrated password hashes work end-to-end.
